data.summary: The Hauptzollamt Musterhafen set the motor vehicle tax (Kraftfahrzeugsteuer) for vehicle MH-BK 510 at €186.00 per year from 1 January 2025. The tax is collected annually in advance by direct debit.
data.explanation: This is a vehicle tax notice (Kraftfahrzeugsteuerbescheid) from German customs. Your annual tax is €186.00 from 1 January 2025 and is collected by direct debit, so you don't need to transfer money yourself. Make sure your account can cover the debit. If you disagree with the amount, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or electronically with the issuing office. The app shows until when. If you don't object by then, the notice becomes final. A tax adviser can help if you are unsure.
